text: Group exhibition with works by the participants of the University Master's in Art and Design Research, MURAD. Each piece unfolds its own imaginary tied to the participants' individual research processes, whether from a formal, theoretical or methodological standpoint.

Artists: Marta Casas, Clara de Sousa, Hong Xu, Huseyin Ozel, Laura Fajardo, Sofia Montecinos, Bai Yuchen, Lu Meng, Lina Fernandez G, Liang Xin, Yu Shilan, Jiaxin Zhang, Sihan Li, Miaomiao Cheng, Unfunny_Curator & Sofía Aguilar.
